name: Jest
summary: The dominant JavaScript test runner of the 2016–2022 era, now ceding ground to Vitest.
what_it_is: A batteries-included test runner with assertions, mocking, snapshot testing and coverage built in, using its own transform pipeline and module registry.
why_it_matters: Jest defined what a JavaScript test runner should include, and its API is the one Vitest deliberately copied. It is declining because that separate transform pipeline means maintaining a second build configuration, which stopped being acceptable once a Vite-native option existed. Still entirely reasonable in projects not built with Vite.
suitable_for: Existing suites where migration is not worth the effort
React Native, where support is strongest
not_suitable_for: New Vite-based projects, where Vitest removes duplicate configuration
Large suites where watch-mode speed is a daily cost
verifiable_facts: Official docs describe a test runner with its own transform pipeline, assertions, mocking and coverage.
context_dependent_guidance: Suitable: Existing suites where migration is not worth the effort
